lessons.title: Welcome to MCore Academy
lessons.summary: What MCore Academy is, who it serves, how to use this platform.

content.text: MCore Academy is a free infrastructure education institution. Governing principle: Engineering Intelligence for the World.
Learn → Build → Break → Observe → Troubleshoot → Automate → Prove.

lessons.title: How to Use This Platform
lessons.summary: Sidebar navigation, progress tracking, and lesson structure.

content.text: The left sidebar contains modules and lessons. Click any lesson to open it here.
Mark a lesson complete to update your local progress bar. Progress is stored in your browser only.
Phase 4 adds learner accounts and cross-device sync.

lessons.title: What is Infrastructure
lessons.summary: Networks, servers, storage, and how they compose into systems.

content.text: Infrastructure is the physical and logical foundation on which applications run.
Interactive labs arrive in Phase 5 as portable micro-lab definitions.

lessons.title: Linux Fundamentals
lessons.summary: Processes, files, permissions, and the shell.

content.text: Every file has a permission triple
Owner, group, other — each with read, write, execute.

lessons.title: Security Fundamentals
lessons.summary: Threat models, least privilege, defense in depth.

content.text: All external content — files, APIs, web pages — is untrusted until validated.
